On 23 May 1971, [[Limerick GAA|Limerick]] won the title following a 3-12 to 3-11 win over [[Tipperary GAA|Tipperary]] in the final. It was their first league title since the [[1946-47 National Hurling League|1946-47 season]] and their 6th National League title overall.{{cite web|url=http://www.hoganstand.com/general/leagues/nhlrecords.aspx|title=National Hurling League Results 1925-2009|publisher=Hogan Stand|accessdate=18 April 2011|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20100805063526/http://www.hoganstand.com/general/leagues/nhlrecords.aspx|archive-date=2010-08-05|url-status=dead}} Kilkenny's [[Eddie Keher]] was the Division 1 top scorer with 2-50. ===Division 1A table=== {| class="wikitable" style="text-align: centre;" !width=20|Pos !width=150|Team !width=20|Pld !width=20|W !width=20|D !width=20|L !width=20|Pts !width=250|Notes |- style |'''1'''||align=left|''' [[Cork GAA|Cork]] '''||'''7'''||'''5'''||'''1'''||'''1'''||'''11''' |- style="background:silver;" |'''2'''||align=left|''' [[Tipperary GAA|Tipperary]] '''||'''7'''||'''5'''||'''0'''||'''2'''||'''10'''|| Division 1 runners-up |- style="background:gold;" |'''3'''||align=left|''' [[Limerick GAA|Limerick]] '''||'''7'''||'''5'''||'''0'''||'''2'''||'''10'''|| Division 1 champions |- style |'''4'''||align=left|''' [[Kilkenny GAA|Kilkenny]] '''||'''7'''||'''4'''||'''0'''||'''3'''||'''8''' |- style |'''5'''||align=left|''' [[Wexford GAA|Wexford]] '''||'''7'''||'''4'''||'''0'''||'''3'''||'''8''' |- style |'''6'''||align=left|''' [[Dublin GAA|Dublin]] '''||'''7'''||'''2'''||'''0'''||'''5'''||'''4''' |- style |'''7'''||align=left|''' [[Offaly GAA|Offaly]] '''||'''7'''||'''1'''||'''1'''||'''5'''||'''3''' |- style="background:#FFC0CB;" |'''8'''||align=left|''' [[Galway GAA|Galway]] '''||'''7'''||'''1'''||'''0'''||'''6'''||'''2'''|| Relegated to Division 1B |} ===Group stage=== {{football box collapsible |date = 8 November 1970 |team1 = [[Tipperary GAA|Tipperary]] |score = 0-11 -
